per_hop.query:
SELECT series.title AS wb_series, series.creator, actress.name AS grace_replaced_actress, role.type AS role_type
FROM series
JOIN roles AS creator_role ON series.id = creator_role.series_id AND creator_role.person_name = 'Hilarie Ross Burton' AND creator_role.type = 'Creator'
JOIN roles AS recurring_role ON series.id = recurring_role.series_id AND recurring_role.type = 'Recurring'
JOIN cast AS grace_cast ON recurring_role.person_name = grace_cast.person_name
JOIN series AS grace_series ON grace_series.title = 'Grace, Replaced' AND grace_cast.series_id = grace_series.id
WHERE series.network = 'The WB';
